HelloStartupEligibility.heading:
Simple to qualify.
Simple to use.
HelloStartupEligibility.description: If your business is registered, genuinely early-stage and within the revenue threshold, you can get Hello at no cost.

cards.title: Registered business
cards.description: A validly registered business entity. Unregistered individuals aren't eligible.

cards.title: Revenue below R$ 360,000
cards.description: Annual revenue must be below R$ 360,000 or the applicable local equivalent.

cards.title: Verified documents
cards.description: Latest financial statement or tax return, registration proof and declaration.

cards.title: One account per business
cards.description: One free Startup account per registered entity. No splitting businesses to stay within limits.

HelloStartupSteps.heading: Four steps. No surprises.
HelloStartupSteps.description: We keep the process simple so you can get back to building your startup.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Fill the form and upload your business documents.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Our team reviews your documents and eligibility.

steps.title: Activation
steps.description: Once approved, your free Hello account goes live.

steps.title: Grow
steps.description: Keep your setup and move to paid when you outgrow the program.

HelloStartupGrow.heading: When you grow, you keep everything.
HelloStartupGrow.description: Your data, conversations and setup stay exactly as they are. No migration. No disruption.

items.question: Is it genuinely free?
items.answer: Yes — within the usage limits above, for as long as you remain eligible.

items.question: Why do you need financial documents?
items.answer: To fairly and consistently verify that your revenue is below R$ 360,000. It is a mandatory requirement of this program.

items.question: What if I exceed the ticket or agent limit?
items.answer: You'll be prompted to upgrade to a paid plan; your account and data continue uninterrupted.

items.question: What happens at annual review if I've grown?
items.answer: You transition to a paid plan — nothing is lost.

items.question: Can access be withdrawn?
items.answer: Yes, if eligibility is no longer met or the Terms are breached.
